docs.title: hgritty's Notebook
docs.text:
Personal Knowledge Base

Blog vs Notebook

The blog is for dated reflections and life updates. The notebook is for structured knowledge that will be revised, searched, linked, and reused.

docs.title: Learn, connect, and keep the useful things alive.
docs.text:
This notebook is a long-term home for course notes, technical maps, project records, reusable workflows, and ideas that deserve more than a one-off blog post.
